description: Strict FIT activity equivalence used to prove that a Garmin activity is (or is not) one of the retained FIT files before any deletion. matches(expected, candidate) = SHA-256 equal OR areEquivalent(expected, candidate). Never throws; any decode problem is 'not equivalent'.
canonicalization: Input must be 1..16 MiB, a FIT file with a valid header and CRC, decode completely, and contain at least one message.
Exactly one FileId message and its type must be Activity (4).
Drop messages: device_info (23), developer_data_id (207), field_description (206). Developer fields are never compared.
Require at least one record (20), one session (18) and one activity (34) among the remaining messages.
For every remaining message in file order: emit message number, then its standard fields ordered by field number, each as (field number, value count, each raw decoded value with its runtime type).
Ignored fields: record field 8 (compressed_speed_distance); every FileId field except field 0 (type).
Header protocol version, header size, local message numbers, definition layout and CRC bytes are not compared.

vectors.name: metadata and header rewrites are equivalent
vectors.given: same activity re-encoded with protocol 1.0, FileId manufacturer development/product 99/serial 987654/name 'other-device', DeviceInfo changed, developer data removed
